_comment: The card list, printings, categories and mechanics come from the read-only TXT and CSV in Test Deck/Testing Deck (PHASE_06 §6.4) and are never copied here.
This file says only what Proxic has DONE with a card: who owns it, what scenario tests it, and what happened.
Edit this, then run: python scripts/mechanics-lab-ledger.py   (CI runs it with --check).
A card not listed here is P8_COVERAGE, Exploratory, NOT_YET_TESTED.
result is one of PASSED, FAILED, NOT_YET_TESTED, BLOCKED_BY_FORGE, BLOCKED_BY_DECK_PACKAGE, BLOCKED_BY_PROTOCOL, BLOCKED_BY_UNSUPPORTED_PRESET, CLASSIFIED.
PASSED needs evidence that ASSERTS the mechanic. A card that merely appeared in a game is not PASSED.

Agent of Kotis.scenario: Battlefield: a creature object, no invented Renew, selecting it is not attacking. Graveyard: Renew offered by Forge as its own action, chosen, resolved by Forge.
Agent of Kotis.evidence: scripts/check-agent-of-kotis.py, run in CI; trace docs/testing/evidence/p6-aa-agent-of-kotis.trace.json (2026-10-20). On the battlefield: a creature, nothing offered for it, attacking only in declareAttackers. Sacrificed to Village Rites, it is in the graveyard under the same id; Forge offers Renew as its own action, it is chosen, paid, the card exiled and two +1/+1 counters placed. No source names the card.
Agent of Kotis.notes: Forge offers Renew before it is affordable (costs are shown, not pre-filtered); choosing it then rolls back cleanly and the card stays in the graveyard -- seen twice in the trace. Required porting CostExile and CostSacrifice, which were stubs.

Panglacial Wurm.scenario: During a library search, Forge offers casting the Wurm from the library; the protocol carries that action inside the search instead of flattening it away.
Panglacial Wurm.evidence: scripts/check-panglacial-wurm.py, run in CI; trace docs/testing/evidence/p6-ae-panglacial-wurm.trace.json (2026-10-20). Evolving Wilds' search is on the stack; Forge asks whether to play the Wurm; it is paid for (seven mana decisions) and goes on the stack ABOVE the search; the search then resumes and a Forest is chosen; the Wurm resolves.
Panglacial Wurm.notes: Forge offers every Wurm in the library in turn; with the mana spent the rest are declined.

Leyline of the Void.scenario: In the opening hand, Forge offers beginning the game with it on the battlefield; it arrives without being cast.
Leyline of the Void.evidence: scripts/check-leyline.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-leyline.spec.ts (browser, in CI), 2026-10-20. Asked before the first turn, one pick per question with Pass for 'no more'; exactly the chosen cards begin on the battlefield, uncast (no stack, no mana); a declined Leyline stays in hand; the opponent's discard is exiled by Forge's replacement -- forced every run in the case that used to fail, before anyone has acted (patch 0001). In the browser: the offer with Forge's wording and a Pass, then the Leyline on the player's own battlefield at turn 1. Screenshots seen/leyline-*.png.
Leyline of the Void.notes: Was a loud stub (chooseSaToActivateFromOpeningHand): any deck with a Leyline stopped the match before turn one. Found 2026-10-20: if nobody acted before the first card moved to a graveyard, Forge skipped the replacement (its last-known battlefield was not refreshed after opening-hand actions). Owner-approved Forge patch forge_patches/0001-leyline-last-known-state.patch fixes it; the rules record is docs/testing/evidence/p6-af-rules-record.md.

Karn Liberated.scenario: The -14 restarts the game; the Arena match id stays coherent while Forge starts a new game.
Karn Liberated.evidence: scripts/check-karn.py (worker, in CI); trace docs/testing/evidence/p6-ad-karn-liberated.trace.json; frontend/e2e/match-karn.spec.ts (browser), 2026-10-20. Cast, +4, +4, -14 through real play; Forge restarts the game in place; the epoch goes 1 -> 2 on every snapshot and question; turn back to 1, life 20 each; the cards exiled with Karn return under the caster's control; both players told 'The game restarted. This is game 2 of the match.'; game 1's last answer re-sent is refused (DUPLICATE) and a game-1 action id against a game-2 question is refused (STALE_DECISION).
Karn Liberated.notes: Forge restarts IN PLACE and keeps card id numbers (its Card.resetUniqueNumber call is commented out), so the epoch -- counted from Forge's GameEventGameRestarted -- is what separates the games; decision ids keep rising across the restart, which is what makes an old answer unacceptable.

Mindslaver.scenario: The controlling player answers the controlled player's decisions; the controlled player cannot.
Mindslaver.notes: Found and fixed: seats were mapped by Player.getLobbyPlayer(), which is the CURRENT controller's, so under Mindslaver the controlled player was filed under the master's seat -- the master got two snapshots a round (one from the controlled player's view) and the controlled player none. Now getOriginalLobbyPlayer(); a mutation run confirms the check catches the old mapping. Other players' hand cards Forge lets the viewer see now travel as otherHands.
Mindslaver.evidence: scripts/check-mindslaver.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-mindslaver.spec.ts (browser), 2026-10-20. During the controlled turn every question for seat 2 is actedForSeat 2, authorisedSeat 1; seat 2 answering one is refused WRONG_SEAT; seat 1 sees seat 2's hand then and not before; each seat gets exactly one snapshot per round, its own; seat 2 answers again afterwards. In the browser: the host is asked under 'Playing for seat 2' and shown 'Pat's hand -- you can see it', the guest is asked nothing. Screenshots seen/mindslaver-*.png.

Pithing Needle.notes: Owner decision 2026-10-20: search, then pick. Forge offers the named card's ability anyway -- its own desktop client does too (getAllPossibleAbilities does not consult CantBeActivated) -- and refuses it on activation.
Pithing Needle.evidence: scripts/check-card-name.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-card-name.spec.ts (browser, in CI), 2026-10-20. The question arrives searchable with 34,334 allowed names and none sent; search ranks the exact name first and ignores accents; a guessed id is refused; the server accepts only names it sent; Evolving Wilds named, its ability is then refused at activation (no sacrifice asked, still on the battlefield). In the browser: a search box, Mountain first for the Needle, no Mountain for Phyrexian Revoker's nonland list.

Adaptive Automaton.scenario: Choose a creature type from Forge's own list.
Adaptive Automaton.evidence: scripts/check-semantic-choices.py (2026-10-19): asked with 356 options, Forge's valid-type list.

Fireball.scenario: Announce X from enumerated options; X is paid and the damage dealt.
Fireball.evidence: scripts/check-x-announcement.py (2026-10-19): X announced, paid and dealt.
Fireball.notes: Dividing damage among several targets is a separate decision and not covered here.

Cryptic Command.scenario: Choose two modes, then targets for each.
Cryptic Command.notes: Mode choice is MET on Alley Evasion and Abrade; not yet run on this card.
Cryptic Command.evidence: scripts/check-modes.py cryptic (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Choose two: the creature returns to its owner's hand and a card is drawn.

Collective Brutality.scenario: Escalate: modes chosen, an extra cost per extra mode.
Collective Brutality.evidence: scripts/check-modes.py escalate (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Two modes chosen one at a time; escalate's discard paid; the creature dies to -2/-2 and 2 life moves. Found: the discard cost (CostDiscard) was a loud stub -- ported from Forge's HumanCostDecision.

Three Steps Ahead.scenario: Spree: optional additional costs per mode.
Three Steps Ahead.evidence: scripts/check-modes.py spree (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Two spree modes, each with its extra cost: a token copy, two drawn and one discarded. Found: discarding from a hand by an effect was a loud stub -- ported.

Season of Weaving.notes: The Pawprint budget is ported from Forge's own human path; not yet run on this card.
Season of Weaving.evidence: scripts/check-modes.py pawprint (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Five one-pawprint modes fit the budget, none offered past it; five drawn.

Tooth and Nail.scenario: Entwine: both modes for an extra cost.
Tooth and Nail.evidence: scripts/check-modes.py entwine (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Entwine offered as an optional cost and paid; creatures searched for and two put onto the battlefield from hand. Found: optional costs were a loud stub -- ported.

Dismember.scenario: Phyrexian mana: pay life or mana per symbol.
Dismember.evidence: scripts/check-costs.py dismember (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. One Swamp pays {1}; {B/P}{B/P} are paid with 4 life (offered as 'Pay 2 life for a Phyrexian symbol'); the creature dies. Found: Phyrexian life payment was not offered at all -- ported from Forge's own input.

Force of Will.scenario: Alternative cost: exile a blue card and pay life.
Force of Will.evidence: scripts/check-costs.py force-of-will (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. With no lands, cast for its alternative cost -- a blue card exiled and 1 life paid -- countering a spell on the stack. Found: NO counterspell could be cast: spells on the stack were never offered as targets (Forge's getAllCandidates excludes the stack); stack targeting ported from Forge's TargetSelection. Also found: exile was missing from the snapshot.

Venerated Loxodon.evidence: scripts/check-costs.py convoke (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Three creatures tapped to convoke {4}{W}; each then gets its +1/+1 counter. Found: convoke/improvise was a loud stub -- ported from Forge's InputSelectCardsForConvokeOrImprovise.

Reverse Engineer.evidence: scripts/check-costs.py improvise (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Three artifacts tapped for {3}, two Islands for {U}{U}; three drawn.

Treasure Cruise.scenario: Delve: exile graveyard cards to pay.
Treasure Cruise.evidence: scripts/check-costs.py delve (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Four graveyard cards exiled pay {4} of {7}{U}; four Islands pay the rest; three drawn. Found: delve was a loud stub (match stopped) -- implemented.

Thoughtcast.evidence: scripts/check-costs.py affinity (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. {4}{U} costs {U} with four artifacts out, none tapped; two drawn. Found: Forge's choice among static abilities was a loud stub -- ported.

Gemrazer.scenario: Mutate onto a creature: one object, two cards.
Gemrazer.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py mutate (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Cast for its mutate cost onto a non-Human creature: still one creature, now Gemrazer's 4/4.

Bottomless Pool // Locker Room.scenario: Room: cast one door, unlock the other.
Bottomless Pool // Locker Room.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py rooms (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Cast by one door ({U}); the other door unlocked for its own {4}{U}. Found: the unlock was offered at the open door's price, {U} -- labels now use the ability's own mana cost.

Dollmaker's Shop // Porcelain Gallery.scenario: Room: cast one door, unlock the other.
Dollmaker's Shop // Porcelain Gallery.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py rooms (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Cast by one door ({1}{W}); Porcelain Gallery unlocked for its own {4}{W}{W}.

Invasion of Zendikar // Awakened Skyclav.scenario: Battle: protected by an opponent, defeated, transforms.
Invasion of Zendikar // Awakened Skyclav.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py battle (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. The Siege enters protected by the opponent, with defense counters; attacked to defeat; exiled and cast transformed as Awakened Skyclave.

Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberratio.scenario: Transform: the same object, the other face.
Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberratio.evidence: scripts/check-multiface.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-multiface.spec.ts (browser, in CI), 2026-10-20. One object id throughout; face Original -> Backside with both face names (Forge's); 1/1 Human Wizard -> 3/2 Human Insect from Forge, not printed text. The top card is shown to its controller before 'Reveal?'; the opponent is told of every reveal and of nothing declined. In the browser: front with its imported picture; back as Insectile Aberration 3/2 with no picture borrowed from the front. Screenshots seen/delver-*.png.
Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberratio.notes: Found: Forge's 'look at' and 'reveal' (PlayerController.reveal) were no-ops in the adapter, so the reveal question was answered blind and opponents never saw reveals; now a private notice to each entitled player. Packages carry front images only, so a transformed card shows no picture rather than the wrong one.

Reckless Stormseeker // Storm-Charged Sl.scenario: Daybound/nightbound: day/night is global state, and the card transforms with it.
Reckless Stormseeker // Storm-Charged Sl.notes: Its artwork in a match was missing until 2026-10-20 (two-faced lookup); MechanicsLabArtTest now covers every two-faced card. Day/night: entering makes it day, carried as the snapshot's dayTime (check-player-state.py); the night transform itself is not yet run.
Reckless Stormseeker // Storm-Charged Sl.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py daybound (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Day becomes night and the card shows Storm-Charged Slasher; day returns and it turns back. Found: the board showed day at night and night by day -- Forge's day/night flag is TRUE FOR NIGHT and was read the other way; check-player-state.py now requires 'day' after a daybound card enters.

Studious First-Year.scenario: Prepare: enters prepared; the prepared spell is copied from exile.
Studious First-Year.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py prepare (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Enters prepared; a copy of Rampant Growth is cast (a land fetched); the creature stays.

Emeritus of Ideation // Ancestral Recall.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py prepare (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Enters prepared; a copy of Ancestral Recall is cast (three drawn); the creature stays.

Bonecrusher Giant // Stomp.scenario: Adventure: cast Stomp, then the Giant from exile.
Bonecrusher Giant // Stomp.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py adventure (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Stomp offered as 'Stomp -- {1}{R}', kills a creature; the Giant waits in exile (now in the snapshot) and is cast from there, the same card. Found: every half was offered at the WHOLE card's cost and name ('Fire // Ice -- {2}{R}{U}'); labels now use the face's own name and cost.

Fire // Ice.scenario: Split card: two castable halves, one object.
Fire // Ice.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py split (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Fire's 2 damage divided as the player chooses (1 to the opponent, 1 to a creature); Ice taps and draws. Found: divided damage was a loud stub -- ported from Forge's InputSelectTargets. Found: every half was offered at the WHOLE card's cost and name ('Fire // Ice -- {2}{R}{U}'); labels now use the face's own name and cost.

Commit // Memory.scenario: Aftermath: one half from hand, the other from the graveyard.
Commit // Memory.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py aftermath (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Commit cast from hand; Memory later from the graveyard (each player to seven), after which the card is exiled. Found: every half was offered at the WHOLE card's cost and name ('Fire // Ice -- {2}{R}{U}'); labels now use the face's own name and cost.

Wear // Tear.evidence: scripts/check-shapes.py fuse (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Fused for {1}{R}{W}: one cast destroys an artifact and an enchantment; each half also offered alone at its own cost. Found: every half was offered at the WHOLE card's cost and name ('Fire // Ice -- {2}{R}{U}'); labels now use the face's own name and cost.

Humility.scenario: Creatures shown as 1/1 with no abilities: current, not printed, characteristics.
Humility.evidence: scripts/check-characteristics.py (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Serra Angel is 4/4 with Flying and Vigilance; under Humility the same object is 1/1 with no keywords -- power, toughness and keywords all Forge's current values, sent on the snapshot.
Humility.notes: The snapshot had no keywords at all until this; they are now Forge's getUnhiddenKeywords titles, shown on the card chip.

Blood Moon.evidence: scripts/check-characteristics.py (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Evolving Wilds is 'Land' with its sacrifice-and-search ability; under Blood Moon it is 'Land - Mountain' and Forge offers only '{T}: Add {R}'.

March of the Machines.scenario: Artifacts shown as creatures with P/T equal to mana value.

Control Magic.scenario: Control changes; the object stays the same object.
Control Magic.evidence: scripts/check-attachments.py (worker, in CI), 2026-10-20. Seat 1's Aura on seat 2's Grizzly Bears: the creature's seat goes 2 -> 1 under the same card id, and Control Magic stays attached to it in both seats' snapshots.

Mind Bend.scenario: Text change: a colour or land-type word replaced.

Krark, the Thumbless.scenario: Coin flip decided by Forge; the result reaches the player; reconnect and duplicates cannot reroll.
Krark, the Thumbless.notes: The property is MET on Mana Clash (not a Lab card); not yet run on this one.

Aetherworks Marvel.scenario: Energy counters carried as player state.

Aether Hub.evidence: scripts/check-player-state.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-state.spec.ts (browser), 2026-10-20. Entering gives an ENERGY counter on its controller, shown as '1 energy'; tapping it for a colour pays {E} (CostPayEnergy, newly ported).
Aether Hub.notes: Found: CostPayEnergy was a stub, so tapping Aether Hub for a colour ended the match; and declining 'which mana ability?' eight times ended it too (scripts/check-mana-choice.py).

Glistener Elf.scenario: Poison counters carried as player state.
Glistener Elf.evidence: scripts/check-player-state.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-state.spec.ts (browser), 2026-10-20. Infect damage arrives as POISON on the defending player, whose life stays 20; shown as '1 poison' on that player's line.

Palace Jailer.evidence: scripts/check-player-state.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-state.spec.ts (browser), 2026-10-20. Entering makes its controller the monarch, a Forge designation on the player, shown as 'monarch'.

White Plume Adventurer.scenario: The initiative and the Undercity dungeon.

Call of the Ring.scenario: The Ring tempts you; a Ring-bearer is chosen.

Platinum Angel.scenario: You can't lose the game: the result is Forge's, never inferred from life.

Angel's Grace.scenario: Can't lose this turn; life restored.

Laboratory Maniac.scenario: Win instead of losing to an empty library.
Laboratory Maniac.evidence: scripts/check-alternate-win.py (worker, in CI); trace docs/testing/evidence/p6-ap-laboratory-maniac.trace.json; frontend/e2e/match-alternate-win.spec.ts (browser), 2026-10-20. Seat 1's library empties with the Maniac out and its next draw wins; nobody attacks and both players end on 20 life; GAME_ENDED says WINNER seat 1 with Forge's reason "has won due to effect of 'Laboratory Maniac'", which both players read on the result line and the match record keeps.

Felidar Sovereign.scenario: Win at 40 life in the upkeep.

Professor of Symbology.notes: OUT_OF_ACCEPTED_SCOPE, recorded here for P6-AR. Learn fetches a Lesson from outside the game; Open Format has no sideboard (§2.45, FMT-002) and the adapter's sideboard is null, so there is nothing to fetch. Which option Forge then offers has not been run.

Expropriate.blocker: Voting is meaningful with more than two players; Open Format seats two (FMT-001).

Minds Aglow.blocker: Join forces is sequential multiplayer; Open Format seats two (FMT-001).

Village Rites.notes: Its sacrifice cost is exercised by the P6-AA scenario (CostSacrifice); the card's own draw is not asserted.

Evolving Wilds.notes: Its search is the surrounding interaction in the P6-AE scenario; the land arriving tapped is not asserted.

Bonesplitter.scenario: Equip, then equip to another creature: the attachment moves.
Bonesplitter.evidence: scripts/check-attachments.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-attachments.spec.ts (browser), 2026-10-20. Equipped to one creature, then another: attachedTo follows it in both seats' views; the browser draws it on the equipped Goblin (4/2).

Pacifism.scenario: An Aura on the opponent's creature, drawn on that creature.
Pacifism.evidence: scripts/check-attachments.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-attachments.spec.ts (browser), 2026-10-20. Seat 1's Aura attached to seat 2's creature in both views; the browser draws it on the opponent's creature as 'Pacifism (yours)' and, for the opponent, 'Pacifism (RudeLeft's)'. Found: the board had drawn it nowhere -- attachments were looked for among their own controller's cards only.

Rabbit Battery.scenario: Reconfigure onto a creature: it becomes Equipment.
Rabbit Battery.evidence: scripts/check-attachments.py (worker, in CI) and frontend/e2e/match-attachments.spec.ts (browser), 2026-10-20. Reconfigured onto a creature: kind no longer creature, types Artifact - Equipment, attachedTo the creature; the browser draws it on the creature and not as a creature of its own.
